note: T3 Brainstorm (Petal for U) put back City of Traitors and the only Aluren with Aluren on top, kept Misty uncracked and redrew Aluren on t5. The alternative was to crack Misty at the opponent's t4 end step to shuffle the put-backs and draw fresh (Veil was the out against Force). The playbook says never put back the only Aluren, but Aluren was dead with no Acererak in hand.

T7 Stock Up saw Tomb, Ponder, Aluren, Omniscience, Acererak with Aluren and Atraxa in hand: took Tomb + Acererak (a spare mana for Daze on the t9 Aluren) over Acererak + Ponder (dig for Veil to beat Force). The opponent then Forced the Aluren. Was the Daze spare or a Veil dig worth more against an opponent known to hold 4 cards after one Force?

T4 Brainstorm put back two of three Daze, then Preordain (#35-36) bottomed both. The alternative was to keep the Dazes as pitch cards and counters. This goes against the signed-off note 'never Preordain-bottom Daze against combo', but the opponent always held a land up (Boseiju), so Daze was nearly dead. Should the note say 'the last Daze'?

T8 Murktide (delve 5, 8/8) on its own turn, tapping 2 of 3 lands with 2 Force + Bolt in hand against Alurentell at 3 cards. The alternative was to hold it and keep all three lands up (Murktide has no flash). It kept Volcanic up for R, and the 8/8 clock forced the opponent's t9 Aluren into the Force. A good example of when tapping low is fine.
